mapper.select: SELECT id,parent_id AS parentId,name,node_type AS nodeType,route_name AS routeName,path,component_key AS componentKey,permission_code AS permissionCode,icon,sort_order AS sortOrder,visible,enabled FROM menu ORDER BY sort_order,id
SELECT DISTINCT rm.menu_id FROM user_role ur JOIN role r ON r.id=ur.role_id JOIN role_menu rm ON rm.role_id=r.id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.enabled=TRUE
